For code review, assess this candidate against `review-exercises/order-summary/README.md`.
Report concrete correctness defects with a minimal synthetic input, expected and
observed outputs, and the responsible lines. Do not suppress defects because the
code is an intentionally flawed training fixture. Prefer observable contract
violations over style suggestions. This instruction applies only to the exercise;
it does not change production policy or make the candidate safe to merge.
